box.validity: upper>lower and both known before signal

B2.name: CONTRACTION_GEOMETRY_DESCENDANT
B2.rule: for N consecutive newly valid box states, box height strictly decreases AND abs(midpoint-EMA35) strictly decreases; arm next breakout

ema.formula: EMA seeded by SMA(first n closed bars), alpha=2/(n+1), then recursive
ema.slope_sign: BUY all 3 EMA rising one bar; SELL all 3 falling one bar

excluded.reason: chart-scale dependent; normalized version would be new preregistered descendant
hybrid oscillator family outside seed core
new microstructure hypothesis; forbidden before PnL

fractal.high_rule: H[t-4] <= H[t-2] AND H[t-3] <= H[t-2] AND H[t-2] > H[t-1] AND H[t-2] > H[t]
fractal.low_rule: L[t-4] >= L[t-2] AND L[t-3] >= L[t-2] AND L[t-2] < L[t-1] AND L[t-2] < L[t]

management_ontology.base_stop: opposite confirmed box boundary frozen at signal time

prerequisites_before_config_hash_freeze: freeze executable same-day close contract in source clock
rearm: same side rearms only after price returns to/inside boundary or that boundary is replaced

triggers.CLOSE_BREAK: completed-bar transition across confirmed boundary; signal at close; fill next executable tick
triggers.TICK_BREAK: first quote transition across confirmed boundary after confirmation; fill next quote
